description: 1991–2020 WMO baseline seasonal precipitation climatology (MAM and OND) per subcounty across Kenya
source: CHIRPS v3 (UCSB Climate Hazards Center) 0.05° observational rainfall gridded blending

columns.bimodal_total_mm: Combined bimodal rainfall total (MAM + OND mm)
columns.mam_pct: Percentage share of bimodal total occurring during MAM (%)
columns.ond_pct: Percentage share of bimodal total occurring during OND (%)
columns.dominant_season: Dominant seasonal rainfall peak (MAM vs OND)
